title: Uncovering the Generative Landscape of Diffusion Models: A Spectral-Guided Quality-Diversity Diffusion Framework
abstract: arXiv:2610.15724v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have emerged as powerful generative priors across domains ranging from molecular design to high-resolution image synthesis. However, standard diffusion sampling is inherently biased toward high-likelihood regions, often limiting the diversity of outputs. In many domains, a single, high-likelihood sample is insufficient. Instead, diverse portfolios of high-performing solutions are required, motivating methods that uncover a model's full expressive range. Here we show that integrating Quality-Diversity (QD) optimisation with diffusion models enables the discovery of diverse, high-performing outputs. We first propose Quality-Diversity Diffusion, a framework that adapts QD to diffusion models by directly optimising the model's latent noise and conditioning embeddings and leveraging embedding models to quantify diversity. translated_title: 揭示扩散模型的生成图景：一种谱引导的质量-多样性扩散框架
translated_abstract: 去噪扩散概率模型已成为从分子设计到高分辨率图像合成等多个领域中强大的生成先验。然而，标准的扩散采样本质上偏向于高似然区域，这往往限制了输出的多样性。在许多领域中，单一的、高似然的样本是不够的，而是需要多样化的高性能解决方案组合，这促使人们需要能够揭示模型完整表达能力范围的方法。本文表明，将质量-多样性优化与扩散模型相结合，能够发现多样化的高性能输出。首先，我们提出了质量-多样性扩散框架，该框架通过直接优化模型的潜在噪声和条件嵌入，并利用嵌入模型来量化多样性，从而将质量-多样性优化适配到扩散模型中。其次，我们引入了一种新颖的h空间谱变异算子，它引导……
tldr: 该论文提出质量-多样性扩散框架，通过直接优化扩散模型的潜在噪声和条件嵌入，并引入新颖的h空间谱变异算子来引导搜索，从而发现多样化且高性能的生成输出。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Quality-Diversity Diffusion framework that directly optimizes the latent noise and conditioning embeddings of diffusion models, combined with a novel h-space Spectral Mutation operator, to uncover diverse and high-performing generative outputs.
